features.name: ascending terrace course
features.notes: Course climbs a hillside or staircase with strong vertical gain and no overhangs.
features.quote: Ascending Terraces: A course climbing a hillside or staircase — strong vertical gain, nothing overhanging.

features.name: zigzag platform route
features.notes: Tall upward path zigzags through the course.
features.quote: The overall path should zigzag upward, creating a tall vertical obby.

features.name: butter pat platforms
features.notes: At least 20 stages; platforms have rounded block shapes and progressively harder spacing or arrangements.
features.quote: Create a large butter squishy obby (obstacle course) with 20+ stages.

features.name: squishy bounce pads
features.notes: Soft-looking trampoline pads among the stages.
features.quote: Squishy bounce pads (soft-looking trampolines that launch players upward)

features.name: sliding butter slabs
features.notes: Platforms span gaps and visibly suggest back-and-forth motion.
features.quote: Butter slabs sliding back and forth across gaps

features.name: rotating platforms
features.notes: Turning platform obstacles along the route.

features.name: fading butter platforms
features.notes: Timed platforms visibly distinct from solid platforms.
features.quote: Butter platforms that fade away a moment after being stepped on.

features.name: narrow balance beams
features.notes: Narrow walkways and beams for careful crossings.

features.name: butter stepping stone paths
features.notes: Small butter platforms crossing open gaps.
features.quote: stepping-stone paths of butter across open gaps

features.name: checkpoint landing pads
features.notes: Wide flat pads every 4-5 stages, each with a flag or marker.
features.quote: Checkpoint platforms every 4-5 stages (wider, with a flag or marker)

features.name: golden finish platform
features.notes: Large celebration area at the end of the climb.
features.quote: A finish platform at the end (large celebration area)

features.name: warm butter color palette
features.notes: Soft rounded squishy surfaces in #FFD700, #FFC107, and #FFE082, with creamy whites and golden accents.
features.quote: Use warm yellows (#FFD700, #FFC107, #FFE082), creamy whites, and golden accents.

excluded.name: stage count setting
excluded.why: configuration control rather than render feature
